tools_helpful.evidence: Scaffolded the WinUI 3 project, seeded MIGRATION-MAPPING.md, and injected 20 TODO[migrate-NNN] anchors (threading). session-log.txt bootstrap block.
Caught a residual UWP namespace reference inside a XAML comment (Styles\Styles.xaml:313 'Windows.UI.Xaml.Controls.ListBoxItem') on first run; PASS after fix. session-log.txt:10030,10080.
Emitted all 19 first-pass errors with actionable CS codes; clean build after fixes ('Build succeeded in 3.5s', session-log.txt:9958).

tools_problematic.problem: Build hung in MarkupCompilePass1/2 for minutes and emitted a non-actionable 'WMC9999: Object reference not set'.
tools_problematic.evidence: session-log.txt:9164-9165, 9431-9732; multiple stop/restart cycles with 120s->600s timeouts. Cleared once the CS0104 type-resolution errors were fixed.

tool_limitations.limitation: The scaffold's .csproj sets ImplicitUsings=enable, which injects a global 'using System.Net.Http'. UWP code that uses 'Windows.Web.Http' then hits CS0104 on HttpClient/HttpRequestMessage/HttpResponseMessage in every such file.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Document (and let the agent apply) a project-wide '<Using Remove="System.Net.Http" />' when the source uses Windows.Web.Http.

doc_errors.wrong: Only the LaunchActivatedEventArgs flavour of CS0104 is documented; the very common Windows.Web.Http vs System.Net.Http ambiguity (caused by the scaffold's implicit global using, not a stale UWP using) is absent.
doc_errors.correct: Add a CS0104 HttpClient/Windows.Web.Http subsection whose fix is a project-wide '<Using Remove="System.Net.Http" />' (deleting a using does not help because ImplicitUsings re-adds it).

special_apis.special_handling: AdaptiveMediaSource request interception keeps the WinRT Windows.Web.Http stack; it must NOT be swapped to System.Net.Http. Resolve the ambiguity by removing the implicit System.Net.Http using, not by rewriting the HTTP calls.

Namespace-only port, but its automation peer does not project AutomationProperties.AutomationId/Name onto the UIA tree; wrap in a named Grid/Border if the media surface must be individually discoverable/named for accessibility.

errors_encountered.error: CS0104 'HttpClient' is an ambiguous reference between System.Net.Http.HttpClient and Windows.Web.Http.HttpClient (x8 files: ContentSelector, Scenario2/3/4/5/6/7, AdaptiveMediaSourceHttpFilterLogger)
errors_encountered.root_cause: Scaffold .csproj ImplicitUsings=enable injects global 'using System.Net.Http'; UWP media code uses Windows.Web.Http, so both types are in scope.
SampleConfiguration.cs (a partial of MainPage, an SDK-sample idiom) duplicated members that also existed in the scaffold MainPage.xaml.cs.
errors_encountered.fix: Removed the duplicate members from SampleConfiguration.cs (session-log.txt:9328-9344).

dev_agent_struggles.where: First full build (7 scenario files + 2 helpers)
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: 19 errors dominated by CS0104 HttpClient/HttpRequestMessage/HttpResponseMessage ambiguity across 8 files
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: ~2-3 turns to diagnose and apply the csproj Using Remove fix
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Scaffold ImplicitUsings global 'using System.Net.Http' collides with Windows.Web.Http used by the media/adaptive-streaming code.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A documented CS0104-HttpClient pattern in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md prescribing the project-wide Using Remove directive.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Build hung for minutes; WMC9999 'Object reference not set'; several stop/restart cycles with escalating timeouts
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Cascade from the unresolved CS0104 errors starving XAML type resolution.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Resolved automatically once the CS0104 fix landed.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Same CS0104-HttpClient pattern; fixing the ambiguity earlier avoids the WMC cascade and the retry/timeout thrash.
